dimension_justifications.soundness: The arithmetic, estimand, and claim boundaries are internally coherent, but every empirical result depends on missing E10–E14 objects. Raw paired outputs, pool identifiers, scorer traces, implementations, statistical code, and registration records are unavailable, so the central empirical claims cannot currently be supported beyond source-reporting.
dimension_justifications.presentation: The title, endpoint hierarchy, section order, and alignment across abstract, results, and conclusion are strong, and the eight-page PDF is clean and legible. Evaluation is nevertheless materially obstructed by the undefined status of the repeatedly invoked “source manuscript,” code-like protocol names and symbols used before definition, ambiguous table columns, and extensive repetition of evidence caveats.
dimension_justifications.contribution: Separating nominal-draw matching, forward-call-count sensitivity, and reveal-order comparisons is potentially useful. However, the contribution is confined to one model-task construction, identifies no individual mechanism, and rests entirely on unverifiable historical measurements, leaving its significance uncertain.

paper_summary: The paper presents a bounded audit of five multiple-choice scoring protocols for LLaDA-8B-Instruct on constructed GSM8K-MC pools. Its sole primary endpoint is a source-reported 13.0-point advantage of s_conf over mc_uniform at matched nominal draws on n=400; secondary results include a 9.0-point high-budget gap and a fresh-pool fixed-order advantage that reverses at answer position 0. The manuscript carefully limits interpretation to finite-pool, realized-schedule protocol non-interchangeability and disclaims component causality, cost equivalence, and generalization. All empirical values are explicitly source-reported and cannot be verified from the submission package.
strongest_verified_contribution: The strongest verifiable contribution is the clear endpoint and protocol hierarchy—especially the separation of matched nominal draws, matched reported forward-call counts, and reveal-order comparisons—which prevents the secondary analyses from being presented as replications or component-level causal evidence.
strengths: Table 1 establishes a useful canonical hierarchy, and the abstract, Sections 4–5, and conclusion consistently report the same endpoint roles, effect directions, and numerical values.
Equation 1 and the surrounding discussion precisely define a finite-pool, realized-schedule estimand and avoid population, stochastic-policy, component-causality, and actual-resource overclaims.
Tables 5 and 6 state their contrast orientation explicitly and place the answer-position-0 reversal next to the aggregate, substantially reducing sign ambiguity.
The manuscript is unusually candid about missing evidence, incomplete citation verification, post-selection, and the limits of forward-call accounting.

The PDF has eight pages, with references beginning on page 5 and appendices thereafter; it is within the stated page limit, visually legible, and anonymous in visible text and PDF metadata. The AI-assistance disclosure is explicit on page 5.
questions: What exactly is the “source manuscript,” who conducted its experiments, and what work was newly performed by the current submission rather than transcribed or reframed?
Can an anonymous, hashed E10–E14 crosswalk with paired outputs, pool manifests, prompts, scorer traces, code, configurations, and statistical scripts be supplied for independent recomputation?
Can the authors provide the timestamped registration and complete hypothesis ledger supporting the “preregistered” and “sole primary” labels?
Does m in Table 4 mean b+c, and do the L=3,…,9 columns in Table 8 count candidate strings rather than items?

issues.location: PDF p. 1, Abstract and Evidence notation; pp. 3–5, Sections 3–6 and Tables 3–5; p. 7, Appendix D and Table 9; reviewer_safe_evidence/experiment_registry.json and repository_inventory.md
issues.observed_evidence: The snapshot demonstrates that the evidence objects are absent: every empirical value is labeled SR/CV, Table 9 marks E10–E15 missing, and experiments A14-X1/X2 are registered as source-reported, not rerun, and unverifiable. Thus the provenance gap is a demonstrated flaw; the truth or falsity of the reported effects is cannot_verify rather than demonstrated false.
issues.why_it_matters: Every headline effect, uncertainty interval, exact test, pool property, and schedule-conditional interpretation depends on unavailable records. Transparent caveats are responsible but cannot substitute for evidence supporting protocol non-interchangeability or preregistration claims.
issues.required_fix: Recover and provide an anonymous experimental bundle resolving E11–E14 to raw paired records, item and construction manifests, mask and reveal-order traces, prompts, model/tokenizer revisions, scorer implementations, configurations, statistical code, and registration records; then regenerate all affected tables from that bundle.
issues.verification_test: Validate bundle hashes and the E11–E14 crosswalk, independently replay each arm, verify pool sizes/balance/disjointness, and recompute every reported accuracy, b/c count, interval, p-value, endpoint role, and schedule-conditioned contrast.
issues.evidence_needed: Machine-readable raw outputs, sampling frames, protocol traces, implementation/configuration snapshots, complete hypothesis families, registration timestamps, and deterministic recomputation instructions.

issues.location: PDF p. 1, Abstract lines 17–29 and Introduction lines 50–53; p. 5, Section 6 lines 240–251; p. 7, Appendix D lines 361–363
issues.observed_evidence: An undefined “source manuscript” is presented as the origin of the design, preregistration, methods, and all results, while the paper also says “we study” and “we audit” and refers to “this revision” and an “earlier draft.” The relationship among that source, its experimenters, and the present contribution is never stated explicitly.
issues.why_it_matters: Readers cannot determine whether the submission is a new empirical study, a reanalysis by the same authors, or a documentary audit of an unavailable external artifact. This ambiguity affects both the paper’s identity and what contribution should be credited.
issues.required_fix: Define the source manuscript and its relationship to the present authors at first mention. Consistently distinguish historical experimental actions, current analyses, and purely editorial reframing across the title, abstract, introduction, results, and conclusion.
issues.verification_test: Ask a blind reader to identify who ran the experiments, what the source artifact is, and what the current submission newly contributes; all three answers should be explicit, and a manuscript-wide verb audit should assign every empirical action to one unambiguous actor and evidence status.
issues.evidence_needed: A precise author-provided provenance statement and, where empirical ownership is claimed, the corresponding source artifact or evidence crosswalk.

issues.location: PDF p. 1, Abstract lines 17–23 and Table 1; definitions appear only on p. 3, Section 3 lines 108–149
issues.observed_evidence: The central finding is initially expressed using s_conf, mc_uniform, L_i, b/c, and “bed” before these terms receive plain-language definitions. Even the later definition of b and c does not explicitly state which discordant direction each denotes.
issues.why_it_matters: A reader cannot interpret what operational protocol change produced the headline 13.0-point contrast from the abstract or Table 1 alone, weakening the paper’s first-pass identity and accessibility.
issues.required_fix: At first use, expand each scorer into a short mechanistic description, define the evaluation bed, and state the b/c orientation. Retain code identifiers only after the plain-language names are established.
issues.verification_test: Run a first-use terminology check over the PDF: every nonstandard symbol and protocol identifier should be defined before its first quantitative claim, and the abstract should permit a correct plain-language paraphrase without consulting Section 3.
issues.evidence_needed: No new experiment is required; revised definitions and terminology are sufficient.

issues.observed_evidence: Table 4 contains an unexplained column m. In Table 8, the L-bin entries sum to four times the item count, indicating candidate-level counts, but this denominator is not stated explicitly. The tables are visually legible and unclipped, so the defect is semantic rather than a rendering failure.
issues.why_it_matters: Undefined denominators and symbols make the random-order comparison and token-length distribution easy to misread and prevent the tables from standing alone.
issues.required_fix: Define m in the Table 4 caption, including whether it equals b+c, and relabel the Table 8 length columns or caption as counts over candidate strings with denominator 4n. Add a concise table note if needed.
issues.verification_test: A reader should correctly recover each table’s unit and denominator from its caption alone; verify that m and the length-bin totals reconcile arithmetically with the reported sample sizes.
issues.evidence_needed: The table-variable dictionary or underlying summary definitions confirming m and the counting unit.

issues.location: PDF p. 1, Evidence notation; captions of Tables 1–5 on pp. 2–5; Section 6 on p. 5; Appendices A, D, and E on pp. 6–8
issues.observed_evidence: The SR/CV status and absence of the experimental bundle are repeated in the evidence-notation paragraph, most table captions, Section 6, and several appendix sections. The caveat itself is precise and necessary, but its repetition occupies substantial argumentative space.
issues.why_it_matters: Repeated status language competes with the protocol insight and makes the paper read partly as a revision audit trail rather than a concise research argument.
issues.required_fix: Keep one prominent evidence-status definition and concise per-table markers, then consolidate detailed package inventories and repeated exact-package statements into one appendix location with cross-references.
issues.verification_test: A reader should still identify the unverifiable status of every empirical result unambiguously, while a repetition audit finds no full restatement of the same package caveat in multiple main-text locations.
issues.evidence_needed: No new evidence is required; this is a consolidation and cross-reference edit.

ethics_concerns: No specific ethics concern is apparent from this bounded model-evaluation study; no human-subject, sensitive-data, or deployment procedure is reported.
llm_usage_disclosure: This review was produced by an isolated AI subagent for internal pre-submission quality control and used only the frozen reviewer-safe snapshot.
evidence_that_would_raise_score: An anonymous E11–E14 bundle independently reproduces all headline effects, discordance counts, intervals, exact tests, pool properties, and endpoint roles.
A precise provenance statement resolves the relationship between the source manuscript, its experimenters, and the present submission, followed by consistent plain-language protocol naming.
Timestamped registration and a complete multiplicity ledger verify the sole-primary designation and reported statistical family.
Multiple persisted schedule and mask realizations, plus tie-robust interaction analysis, show which conclusions remain stable beyond the single recorded traces.
A bibliography-wide primary-source audit confirms the remaining metadata, sentence support, and contribution boundary.
evidence_that_would_lower_score: Independent recomputation changes any headline effect, b/c count, interval, or p-value.
Recovered sampling records reveal pool overlap, imbalance, choice-construction errors, or tokenization mismatches that invalidate pairing or subgroup summaries.
Registration timing or the complete hypothesis ledger shows that the matched-L endpoint or its role was selected after observing results.
Additional random schedules or mask streams frequently reverse the reported protocol ordering.
The source manuscript cannot be identified as a legitimate, auditable provenance source for the current submission.
review_limitations: The central experimental artifacts were absent, so empirical correctness and reproducibility remain cannot_verify.
Citation assessment was limited to the included partial citation lock; no internet or external literature was consulted.
Only the compiled PDF and source hashes were available, so source-level template and cross-reference checks could not be performed.
The presentation assessment included all eight rendered PDF pages and PDF metadata but no material outside the frozen snapshot.
